tests.name: Invalid subscription request with empty body (missing required nfStatusNotificationUri)
violated_constraints: The request body MUST be present and MUST conform to the SubscriptionData schema.

tests.name: NFStatusSubscribe - missing required nfStatusNotificationUri
violated_constraints: The nfStatusNotificationUri property is required in the SubscriptionData request body.

tests.name: Subscription creation with non-JSON Content-Type
violated_constraints: The request body content type for the subscription creation MUST be application/json.

tests.name: NFStatusSubscribe - sharedDataIds present as empty array
violated_constraints: If sharedDataIds is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 item.

tests.name: invalid_subscriptionId_contains_hyphen
violated_constraints: The subscriptionId property, when present, MUST match the regular expression '^([0-9]{5,6}-(x3Lf57A:nid=[A-Fa-f0-9]{11}:)?)?[^-]+$'.

tests.name: Invalid_Subscription_Includes_ReadOnly_subscriptionId
violated_constraints: The subscriptionId property is marked as readOnly, indicating it is provided by the server (response) rather than the client (request).

tests.name: reqNotifEvents as string instead of array
violated_constraints: If reqNotifEvents is present, it MUST be an array and MUST contain at least 1 item, each item being one of the NotificationEventType enum values (e.g. NF_REGISTERED, NF_DEREGISTERED, NF_PROFILE_CHANGED, SHARED_DATA_CHANGED).

tests.name: Invalid subscription with empty reqSnssais array
violated_constraints: If reqSnssais is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 ExtSnssai item.

tests.name: Invalid_reqPerPlmnSnssais_empty_array
violated_constraints: If reqPerPlmnSnssais is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnSnssai item.

tests.name: Invalid subscription with empty reqPlmnList
violated_constraints: If reqPlmnList is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnId item.

tests.name: Invalid subscription with empty reqSnpnList
violated_constraints: If reqSnpnList is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnIdNid item.

tests.name: ServingScopeEmptyArray_ViolateMinItems
violated_constraints: If servingScope is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 string item.

tests.name: Invalid request including readOnly property nrfSupportedFeatures
violated_constraints: Included readOnly property 'nrfSupportedFeatures' in the request body. 'nrfSupportedFeatures' is defined as readOnly and MUST NOT be provided by the client in requests (requesterFeatures is writeOnly and may be provided).

tests.name: Invalid: client provides readOnly nrfSupportedFeatures in subscription request
violated_constraints: The nrfSupportedFeatures property is readOnly and is defined by the server; it must not be provided by the client in the request.

tests.name: extPreferredLocality with empty array violates minItems
tests.violated_constraints: extPreferredLocality property 'regionA' contains an empty array; each property value MUST be an array with at least 1 LocalityDescription item.

tests.name: Invalid_completeProfileSubscription_wrong_type_string
violated_constraints: completeProfileSubscription must be a boolean (writeOnly); provided type: string

tests.name: Invalid subscrCond - non-conforming object
violated_constraints: subscrCond, if present, MUST conform to one of the SubscrCond variants (oneOf): NfInstanceIdCond, NfInstanceIdListCond, NfTypeCond, ServiceNameCond, ServiceNameListCond, AmfCond, GuamiListCond, NetworkSliceCond, NfGroupCond, NfGroupListCond, NfSetCond, NfServiceSetCond, UpfCond, ScpDomainCond, NwdafCond, NefCond, or DccfCond.

tests.name: Subscription with NfInstanceIdCond but missing nfInstanceId
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NfInstanceIdCond, the nfInstanceId property is required.

tests.name: Subscribe with empty nfInstanceIdList in subscrCond (violates required minItems)
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NfInstanceIdListCond, the nfInstanceIdList property is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item.

tests.name: Subscription with NfTypeCond including forbidden nfGroupId
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NfTypeCond, the nfType property is required, and the schema explicitly prohibits presence of nfGroupId or the pair conditionType + nfGroupIdList in that variant.

tests.name: NFStatusSubscribe_MissingServiceName_WhenSubscrCondIsServiceNameCond
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is ServiceNameCond, the serviceName property is required.

tests.name: NFStatusSubscribe_Invalid_SubscrCond_ServiceNameListCond_WrongConditionType_EmptyServiceList
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is ServiceNameListCond, both conditionType and serviceNameList properties are required and conditionType MUST have the value 'SERVICE_NAME_LIST_COND', and serviceNameList MUST contain at least 1 item.

tests.name: Subscribe with AmfCond but missing amfSetId and amfRegionId
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is AmfCond, at least one of amfSetId or amfRegionId MUST be present.

tests.name: Subscription with GuamiListCond but empty guamiList
tests.violated_constraints: If subscrCond is GuamiListCond, guamiList is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item.

tests.name: Subscription with NetworkSliceCond and empty snssaiList
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NetworkSliceCond, snssaiList is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item (snssaiList is empty).
If nsiList is present it MUST contain at least 1 item (nsiList is empty).

tests.name: NFStatusSubscribe_Invalid_NfGroupCond_NfTypeNotAllowed
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NfGroupCond, both nfType and nfGroupId are required and nfType is restricted to the enum [UDM, AUSF, UDR, PCF, CHF, HSS, BSF, UDSF]; nfType='NRF' violates the allowed nfType enumeration.

tests.name: NFStatusSubscribe_Invalid_NfGroupListCond_EmptyNfGroupIdList
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NfGroupListCond, nfGroupIdList MUST contain at least 1 item (nfGroupIdList is empty).

tests.name: Missing nfSetId when subscrCond is NfSetCond
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NfSetCond, nfSetId is required.

tests.name: subscrCond NfServiceSetCond without nfServiceSetId
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NfServiceSetCond, nfServiceSetId is required.

tests.name: Subscribe with UpfCond but invalid conditionType
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is UpfCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'UPF_COND'.

tests.name: Invalid subscription with NwdafCond having incorrect conditionType
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NwdafCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'NWDAF_COND'.

tests.name: NFStatusSubscribe_invalid_subscrCond_conditionType_not_NEF_COND
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is NefCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'NEF_COND'.

tests.name: Invalid subscription: DccfCond with incorrect conditionType
violated_constraints: If subscrCond is DccfCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'DCCF_COND'.

tests.name: NFStatusSubscribe_invalid_notifCondition_both_monitored_and_unmonitored
violated_constraints: notifCondition, if present, MUST NOT contain both monitoredAttributes and unmonitoredAttributes at the same time (both are present)

tests.name: Subscription with nfStatusNotificationUri pointing to NRF's own subscriptions endpoint (callback loop)
violated_constraints: The nfStatusNotificationUri value provided in the request body is used as the callback endpoint for notifications (the callback definition uses '{$request.body#/nfStatusNotificationUri}' as the callback URI to POST NotificationData).
